description: This file defines a CKEditor plugin that integrates Drupal Media with the General HTML Support plugin, handling view-to-model and model-to-view attribute conversions for Drupal Media elements.

classes.name: DrupalMediaGeneralHtmlSupport
classes.description: A CKEditor plugin class that manages the integration of Drupal Media with the General HTML Support plugin, including schema extension and conversion registration.

methods.name: viewToModelDrupalMediaAttributeConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter function that preserves HTML attributes on Drupal Media elements during view-to-model conversion.

methods.name: getDescendantElement
methods.description: Retrieves a descendant element with a specific name from a container element.

methods.name: modelToDataAttributeConverter
methods.description: Converts model attributes to view attributes during data downcast.

methods.name: modelToEditingViewAttributeConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter that updates view attributes in the editing view for Drupal Media.

methods.name: modelToDataViewAttributeConverter
methods.description: Creates a converter that updates view attributes in the data view for Drupal Media.
